title: AutoLexSteer: Automatic Contrast Construction for Lexical Activation Steering
abstract: arXiv:2609.06879v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Steering vectors have rapidly emerged as a popular and effective method for guiding the output of LLMs in very specific ways. But constructing accurate steering vectors is a difficult manual process due to the opacity of embeddings. We introduce Hangman, a novel type of steering vector that operates using word senses, as well as AutoLexSteer, the first fully automated process for building steering vectors. AutoLexSteer employs families of closely-related words extracted from WordNet to specify both the steering source to be avoided and the desired steering target. The steering vectors are quite precise, can be used to steer at the level of words and sets of word senses (meanings), and are able to steer certain LLM behaviors like sycophancy. The dataset and code can be found at https://github.com/ShuheWang1998/autolexsteer.

translated_title: AutoLexSteer：面向词汇激活引导的自动对比构建方法
translated_abstract: 引导向量已迅速成为一种流行且有效的方法，能够以非常具体的方式引导大语言模型（LLM）的输出。但由于嵌入表示的不透明性，构建精确的引导向量是一项困难的手工过程。我们提出了Hangman，一种基于词义运作的新型引导向量，同时提出了AutoLexSteer，这是首个完全自动化的引导向量构建流程。AutoLexSteer利用从WordNet中提取的密切相关词族，来指定需要避开的引导源以及期望达到的引导目标。这些引导向量非常精确，可以在词语和词义集合（含义）的层面进行引导，并且能够引导某些LLM行为，例如谄媚性。数据集和代码可在 https://github.com/ShuheWang1998/autolexsteer 获取。
tldr: 该论文提出了基于词义的Hangman引导向量以及首个全自动化引导向量构建流程AutoLexSteer，通过利用WordNet中的相关词族，实现了在词语和词义层面对LLM行为（如谄媚性）的精确引导。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Hangman, a novel word-sense-based steering vector, and AutoLexSteer, the first fully automated pipeline for constructing steering vectors using WordNet word families, enabling precise steering of LLM behaviors such as sycophancy at the word and word-sense level.
